payload.leagueSummary: NET is a knife fight at the top: MattF, Dan94, KeithK75, and even HamSammich are all clustered within a pretty tight band, which means the window is being decided by who can avoid the dumb doubles and keep the putter from face-planting. Under the hood, the cleanest golf belongs to KeithK75 and Dan94, who keep showing up with elite tee-to-green work and enough birdies to make the rest of the room look like it’s still warming up. The uglier side of the window is also loud: a few players are getting dragged around by weak tee balls, shaky approach play, and enough three-putt energy to power a small city.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the class of the gross board, but Dan94’s net position is a touch better right now because the matchups are being settled in the scoring margin, not just raw ball-striking.
MattF is the putter-fueled menace in the mix: elite tee and putting numbers, enough to survive when the rest of the card gets a little greasy.

The bottom half is a mud fight of bad approach play and too many doubles; Leroy4522, Jakobm90, and MashedBROtato are getting punished by missing the target and then paying the full idiot tax around the greens.
